tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search job listings by keyword, location, type, or remote policy. Returns paginated results with title, company, salary, and application URL.

api_key.description: Optional: your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Prefer sending it as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead of this argument — the header never enters the conversation/tool-call log the way this argument does. When provided (either way) and valid, results are personalized (e.g. includes whether you saved a job).

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get full details of a job listing by its slug or ID, including description, requirements, company info, and application link.

slug.description: Job slug (URL-friendly identifier) or job ID

api_key.description: Optional: your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Prefer sending it as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead of this argument — the header never enters the conversation/tool-call log the way this argument does. When provided (either way) and valid, results are personalized (e.g. includes whether you saved a job).

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Fetch the latest news articles. Optionally filter by category, locale, or title keyword. Returns title, summary, publication date, and URL.

tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: List all content categories available on the platform (for filtering news, jobs, etc.).

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search companies on the platform. Returns company name, industry, location, size, website, and open roles count.

tools.name: estimate_project_price
tools.description: Estimate what a website, a logo or a translation costs to have made by a freelancer: a typical price range for Budget, Professional and Premium freelancers, hours, working days, a line-item breakdown, the assumptions, and the questions whose answers would narrow the range. Deterministic and transparent (scope → hours → global hourly rates; no region pricing). For translations the tiers are processes: Budget = machine draft edited by a translator, Professional = human translation, Premium = adds a second linguist; every language pair costs the same. Pass only what the user actually said — leave the rest out and the range widens honestly. Returns a link to the full estimate, where it can be posted as a gig to get proposals.

layouts.description: website: how many pages look different from each other

design.description: website: ready-made theme, a substantially adapted theme, or designed from scratch

content.description: website: does the client have the text ("needed" = the freelancer writes it)

cms.description: website: the client edits content themselves

integrations.description: website: third-party tools to connect (CRM, newsletter, booking …)

hosting.description: website: the freelancer sets up hosting, domain and launch

deliverables.description: logo: logo only, logo + variants, or a brand kit

usage.description: logo: who uses it and how widely (logos are priced by value)

words.description: translation: words in the source text

target_languages.description: translation: the languages to translate into (names or codes; each is priced as its own target). The source language and the pair never change the price.

domain.description: translation: the kind of text (marketing is adapted, not translated literally)

repetitions.description: translation: % of sentences that repeat (billed at 30%)

format.description: translation: plain text, Word/Excel/PowerPoint, software strings (JSON/XLIFF/PO), or a design file (InDesign/Figma)

glossary.description: translation: build a terminology glossary first

tools.name: get_platform_stats
tools.description: Get high-level statistics about the Datronis platform: total active jobs, jobs indexed in the last 7 days, companies, countries represented, news articles, and users.

tools.name: apply_to_job
tools.description: Submit a job application on behalf of the authenticated user. Requires a personal access token (generate one at /app/api-keys/). A resume is mandatory: if no resume_id is given, the user's default (or most recently updated) resume is used automatically, and the call fails with a clear error if the user has no resume yet.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

job_id.description: Job ID to apply for (from search_jobs or get_job)

resume_id.description: Resume to attach. If omitted, your default resume (or most recently updated) is used automatically.

tools.name: list_my_resumes
tools.description: List the authenticated user's saved resumes. Requires a personal access token (generate one at /app/api-keys/).

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

query.description: Search keyword in resume title or headline

tools.name: get_my_applications
tools.description: Check the status of the authenticated user's job applications. Requires a personal access token (generate one at /app/api-keys/).

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

tools.name: draft_news
tools.description: Draft and publish a news article. Open to anyone with a Datronis account — the personal access token is for rate-limiting and audit, not permission-gating. Always drafted in English first; an automated safety classifier must return "green" (not political, not likely to be seen as controversial or divisive) before the article goes live. A "flagged" result creates the article unpublished and returns the reasons — use resubmit_news with revised content to try again; there is no way to force-publish a flagged article. Publishes English-only unless target_locales is given.

body.description: Article body in the format selected by content_format

content_format.description: Body format. Use "markdown" for headings, tables, lists, code blocks, links and images; use "html" for rich HTML with classes and inline CSS. Defaults to html for backward compatibility.

category_id.description: Category ID; defaults to the site's default news category

target_locales.description: Optional 2-letter locale codes to also translate and publish into (e.g. ["de","ru"]). English is always published first. Omit to publish English-only — broad multi-language publishing is only ever done when explicitly requested. There is no limit on how many locales may be requested here.

allow_self_translation.description: Reserves (does not yet grant a UI for) your permission to personally translate this article into additional locales later, beyond target_locales. Defaults to true — checked by default. Only ever applies to a locale after the English original has been classified "green"; a "flagged" article carries no translation permission regardless of this flag.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why). Publishing is open to anyone with an account — this token exists for rate-limiting and an audit trail, not to gate who may publish.

tools.name: resubmit_news
tools.description: Revise and reclassify a news article that draft_news (or a previous resubmit_news call) rejected as "flagged". Every call is its own fully logged classification attempt against the news_id's audit trail — never a silent status flip. Publishes the revision live only if the classifier now returns "green". Only the account that originally submitted the article (via draft_news) may resubmit it — a different account's api_key is rejected, even a valid one.

news_id.description: The news_id returned by a previous draft_news call

content_format.description: Body format. Use "markdown" for headings, tables, lists, code blocks, links and images; use "html" for rich HTML with classes and inline CSS. Defaults to html for backward compatibility.

target_locales.description: Same as draft_news — only used if this revision is approved

allow_self_translation.description: Same as draft_news. Omit to leave the article's existing setting unchanged; pass explicitly to change it.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why). Publishing is open to anyone with an account — this token exists for rate-limiting and an audit trail, not to gate who may publish.

tools.name: get_missing_news_translations
tools.description: List published English news articles and which locale codes they are still missing a translation for. Pass locale to focus on one language at a time. Use this to find work for submit_news_translation — this tool only reports gaps, it never translates anything itself.

locale.description: Optional 2-letter locale code (e.g. "fi") to only return articles missing that specific translation. Omit to see every published article missing at least one locale.

tools.name: submit_news_translation
tools.description: Publish your own translation of an already-published English article into a new locale. Unlike draft_news's target_locales (which asks Datronis's own server to translate it), the translated title/body you pass here is published as-is — you (the calling AI) do the translation. Open to anyone with an account, same as draft_news; the source article must already be live, and only one translation may exist per (article, locale) — a locale that already has a translation is rejected, use get_missing_news_translations to find real gaps first.

news_id.description: The news_id of the published English source article (from get_news or get_missing_news_translations)

locale.description: 2-letter target locale code (e.g. "fi") — see get_missing_news_translations for what a given article still needs

title.description: Translated title, in the target locale

body.description: Translated body, in the target locale — HTML or plain text, same format as the source

content_format.description: Body format. Use "markdown" for headings, tables, lists, code blocks, links and images; use "html" for rich HTML with classes and inline CSS. Defaults to html for backward compatibility.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why). Publishing is open to anyone with an account — this token exists for rate-limiting and an audit trail, not to gate who may publish.

tools.name: admin_create_news
tools.description: Admin-only: publish a news article directly into any locale, any status, with no safety classifier and no English-first requirement. Requires an api_key belonging to an admin account — a valid but non-admin key is rejected. For non-admin accounts, use draft_news instead. Can also queue selected translations or every missing locale without keeping the MCP request open while translation runs.

title.description: Article title, in the target locale

body.description: Article body in the format selected by content_format

content_format.description: Body format. Use "markdown" for headings, tables, lists, code blocks, links and images; use "html" for rich HTML with classes and inline CSS. Defaults to html for backward compatibility.

locale.description: 2-letter locale code to publish directly into (e.g. "en", "de") — no English-first requirement, unlike draft_news

category_id.description: Category ID; defaults to the site's default news category

published.description: Whether the article goes live immediately. Defaults to true. No safety classifier runs either way — admin judgment only.

target_locales.description: Optional locale codes to translate in the durable background queue after creating the article. Use translate_to_all instead when every missing locale is wanted.

translate_to_all.description: When true, queue every missing locale after creating the article. The tool returns immediately; use admin_get_news_translation_status to follow progress.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why). The token must belong to an admin account — a valid but non-admin key is rejected.

tools.name: admin_edit_news
tools.description: Admin-only: edit any existing news article — title, body, category, or published status — regardless of who created it or what locale it is in. Requires an api_key belonging to an admin account. Unlike resubmit_news, there is no ownership restriction and no safety classifier; omit a field to leave it unchanged.

news_id.description: The news_id of any existing article — not limited to ones the caller created

title.description: New title. Omit to leave unchanged.

body.description: New body. Omit to leave unchanged.

content_format.description: Body format. Use "markdown" for headings, tables, lists, code blocks, links and images; use "html" for rich HTML with classes and inline CSS. Defaults to html for backward compatibility.

category_id.description: New category ID. Omit to leave unchanged.

published.description: Publish or unpublish the article. Omit to leave the current status unchanged.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why). The token must belong to an admin account — a valid but non-admin key is rejected.

tools.name: admin_translate_news
tools.description: Admin-only: durably queue server-generated translations for an existing published news article. Pass target_locales for selected languages, or omit it to fill every missing locale across all 24 supported languages. Existing translations are skipped and each locale has a deterministic task, so repeating the call is safe. This call returns quickly; use admin_get_news_translation_status until complete=true.

news_id.description: Any published news row in the translation family.

target_locales.description: Locale codes to fill (for example ["fa","de"]). Omit to queue every locale that is still missing. Existing translations are skipped, so retries are safe.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why). The token must belong to an admin account — a valid but non-admin key is rejected.

tools.name: admin_get_news_translation_status
tools.description: Admin-only: inspect translation coverage and durable queue state for a news article. Returns existing locale rows, missing locale codes, per-locale QUEUED/PROCESSING/COMPLETED/FAILED jobs, and complete=true only when all 24 languages exist.

news_id.description: Any news row in the translation family.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why). The token must belong to an admin account — a valid but non-admin key is rejected.

tools.name: create_resume
tools.description: Create a new resume for the authenticated user by directly specifying its content — name, headline, summary, contact info, work experience, education, skills, projects, certificates. Unlike the human resume builder at /app/resume-builder/, this tool skips layout and styling entirely — Datronis applies sensible defaults, which the user can still adjust later in the builder without losing anything you wrote. Requires a personal access token.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

title.description: Internal title to identify this resume, e.g. "Backend Engineer — EU". Defaults to "Untitled Resume".

locale.description: 2-letter locale code for this resume version, e.g. "en", "de". Defaults to "en".

is_default.description: Make this the default resume — used by apply_to_job when no resume_id is given.

name.description: Full name shown on the resume header.

headline.description: Short professional title under the name, e.g. "Senior Software Engineer".

location.description: City, Country shown in the header.

contact.description: Contact links shown in the header.

experiences.description: Work history, most recent first. If provided, replaces this entire section — send the complete list, not just what changed.

projects.description: Projects section. If provided, replaces this entire section — send the complete list, not just what changed.

skills.description: Skill categories. If provided, replaces this entire section — send the complete list, not just what changed.

certificates.description: Certifications. If provided, replaces this entire section — send the complete list, not just what changed.

education.description: Education history. If provided, replaces this entire section — send the complete list, not just what changed.

customSections.description: Extra named sections not covered above (awards, publications, volunteering, etc). If provided, replaces this entire section — send the complete list, not just what changed.

tools.name: update_resume
tools.description: Update an existing resume's content and/or metadata (title, locale, status, default flag). By default this merges: fields you omit stay as they are, and any section array you DO send (experiences, education, skills, projects, certificates, customSections) replaces that one section while every other section is untouched — call list_my_resumes first if you need to see current content before adding to it (e.g. appending one job to an existing experience list). Requires a personal access token.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

resume_id.description: The resume to update — from list_my_resumes.

title.description: New internal title. Omit to leave unchanged.

locale.description: New locale code. Omit to leave unchanged.

status.description: New status. Omit to leave unchanged.

is_default.description: Make this the default resume. Omit to leave unchanged.

full_replace.description: false (default): merge — fields you omit stay as they are; any section array you DO send (experiences, education, skills, projects, certificates, customSections) replaces that one section, other sections are untouched. true: the content fields you send become the ENTIRE resume — any section you omit is removed. Call list_my_resumes first to see current content before adding to an existing section.

name.description: Full name shown on the resume header.

headline.description: Short professional title under the name, e.g. "Senior Software Engineer".

location.description: City, Country shown in the header.

contact.description: Contact links shown in the header.

experiences.description: Work history, most recent first. If provided, replaces this entire section — send the complete list, not just what changed.

projects.description: Projects section. If provided, replaces this entire section — send the complete list, not just what changed.

skills.description: Skill categories. If provided, replaces this entire section — send the complete list, not just what changed.

certificates.description: Certifications. If provided, replaces this entire section — send the complete list, not just what changed.

education.description: Education history. If provided, replaces this entire section — send the complete list, not just what changed.

customSections.description: Extra named sections not covered above (awards, publications, volunteering, etc). If provided, replaces this entire section — send the complete list, not just what changed.

tools.name: list_memo_decks
tools.description: List the authenticated user's Memo flashcard decks with card counts, how many cards are due today, and each deck's front/back language. Requires a personal access token with the "memo" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

timezone.description: The user's IANA timezone, e.g. "Europe/Berlin" or "Asia/Tokyo". Decides what "due today" and "which day" mean. Defaults to UTC — pass it whenever you know it.

tools.name: create_memo_deck
tools.description: Create a new Memo flashcard deck, optionally with its first cards (up to 200). For language learning set front_lang/back_lang (BCP-47, e.g. "es-ES" / "en-US") so the user hears correct free text-to-speech in the browser. Requires a personal access token with the "memo" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

front_lang.description: BCP-47 language of the FRONT side, e.g. "ja-JP" — used for free in-browser text-to-speech. Omit to auto-detect.

back_lang.description: BCP-47 language of the BACK side, e.g. "en-US". Omit to auto-detect.

front.description: Prompt side — e.g. a word in the language being learned, or a question. Markdown is rendered on both the web app and the study flashcard: **bold**, _italic_, ~~strike~~, `code`, bullet/numbered lists, > quotes, and [links](url). A single newline renders as a line break (no need for a blank line between lines of the same side).

back.description: Answer side — e.g. the translation or answer. Markdown is rendered on both the web app and the study flashcard: **bold**, _italic_, ~~strike~~, `code`, bullet/numbered lists, > quotes, and [links](url). A single newline renders as a line break (no need for a blank line between lines of the same side).

hint.description: Optional clue shown before the answer is revealed. Markdown is rendered on both the web app and the study flashcard: **bold**, _italic_, ~~strike~~, `code`, bullet/numbered lists, > quotes, and [links](url). A single newline renders as a line break (no need for a blank line between lines of the same side).

cards.description: Optional cards to add right away (up to 200; use add_memo_cards for more).

tools.name: update_memo_deck
tools.description: Rename or restyle a Memo deck, or change its front/back language. Only fields you pass change. Requires a personal access token with the "memo" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

front_lang.description: BCP-47 language of the front side. Empty string clears it.

back_lang.description: BCP-47 language of the back side. Empty string clears it.

tools.name: list_memo_cards
tools.description: List or search flashcards. With deck_id: that deck's cards (newest first). With only a query: search across all the user's decks — use this to find "the card about X" before editing or reviewing it. Every card includes `schedule`: stage (new/learning/review/mature), step, interval_days, due_date and due_in_days. Requires a personal access token with the "memo" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

deck_id.description: Deck to list. Omit together with a `query` to search across ALL of the user's decks.

query.description: Text to search in front/back/hint, or an exact tag.

timezone.description: The user's IANA timezone, e.g. "Europe/Berlin" or "Asia/Tokyo". Decides what "due today" and "which day" mean. Defaults to UTC — pass it whenever you know it.

tools.name: get_memo_card
tools.description: Get one flashcard and exactly where it sits in its spaced-repetition cycle: stage, step (consecutive successful recalls), interval, ease, next due date, lapses, its position in the deck's study queue (queue_position of queue_size), and its last 10 reviews. Requires a personal access token with the "memo" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

card_id.description: Card id — from list_memo_cards or get_memo_study_queue.

timezone.description: The user's IANA timezone, e.g. "Europe/Berlin" or "Asia/Tokyo". Decides what "due today" and "which day" mean. Defaults to UTC — pass it whenever you know it.

tools.name: add_memo_cards
tools.description: Add 1–500 flashcards to a deck in one call, or update existing ones. mode "add" (default) skips exact duplicates (same front AND back, ignoring case and spacing), so re-sending a list is safe; mode "update" overwrites the answer of cards whose front already exists, keeping their review progress. Returns created/updated/unchanged/skipped counts. Requires a personal access token with the "memo" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

deck_id.description: Deck to add to — from list_memo_decks or create_memo_deck.

front.description: Prompt side — e.g. a word in the language being learned, or a question. Markdown is rendered on both the web app and the study flashcard: **bold**, _italic_, ~~strike~~, `code`, bullet/numbered lists, > quotes, and [links](url). A single newline renders as a line break (no need for a blank line between lines of the same side).

back.description: Answer side — e.g. the translation or answer. Markdown is rendered on both the web app and the study flashcard: **bold**, _italic_, ~~strike~~, `code`, bullet/numbered lists, > quotes, and [links](url). A single newline renders as a line break (no need for a blank line between lines of the same side).

hint.description: Optional clue shown before the answer is revealed. Markdown is rendered on both the web app and the study flashcard: **bold**, _italic_, ~~strike~~, `code`, bullet/numbered lists, > quotes, and [links](url). A single newline renders as a line break (no need for a blank line between lines of the same side).

cards.description: Cards to add or update (1–500 per call).

mode.description: add (default): add only cards that are not in the deck yet — a duplicate is the same front AND back (ignoring case/spacing), so re-sending a list is safe. update: cards whose front already exists get their back (and hint/tags, when you pass them) overwritten, keeping their review progress; new fronts are added. Replacing a whole deck is intentionally not available over MCP.

tools.name: export_memo_deck
tools.description: Export every card of a deck (front, back, hint, tags) plus the deck's settings as JSON — for a backup, for converting the deck to another format for the user, or for copying it elsewhere. The same shape can be imported back with add_memo_cards or the web importer. Requires a personal access token with the "memo" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

tools.name: update_memo_card
tools.description: Edit a flashcard's front, back, hint or tags. Only fields you pass change; the card keeps its review schedule. Requires a personal access token with the "memo" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

front.description: Markdown is rendered on both the web app and the study flashcard: **bold**, _italic_, ~~strike~~, `code`, bullet/numbered lists, > quotes, and [links](url). A single newline renders as a line break (no need for a blank line between lines of the same side).

back.description: Markdown is rendered on both the web app and the study flashcard: **bold**, _italic_, ~~strike~~, `code`, bullet/numbered lists, > quotes, and [links](url). A single newline renders as a line break (no need for a blank line between lines of the same side).

hint.description: Empty string removes the hint. Markdown is rendered on both the web app and the study flashcard: **bold**, _italic_, ~~strike~~, `code`, bullet/numbered lists, > quotes, and [links](url). A single newline renders as a line break (no need for a blank line between lines of the same side).

tools.name: get_memo_study_queue
tools.description: Get the cards due today (reviews first, then new cards) so you can quiz the user in chat: show the front, let them answer, reveal the back, then call review_memo_card with how well they did. Requires a personal access token with the "memo" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

deck_id.description: Limit to one deck. Omit for every deck.

timezone.description: The user's IANA timezone, e.g. "Europe/Berlin" or "Asia/Tokyo". Decides what "due today" and "which day" mean. Defaults to UTC — pass it whenever you know it.

tools.name: review_memo_card
tools.description: Record the user's answer to a flashcard and reschedule it (SM-2 spaced repetition) — exactly the same as rating it in the web app, and it counts toward their activity calendar and streak. Also use this when the user says they already know a card ("easy" pushes it days ahead). Returns the card's new schedule. Requires a personal access token with the "memo" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

rating.description: How well the USER recalled it: again = forgot, hard = recalled with real difficulty, good = recalled, easy = instant. Use "easy" when the user says they already know the card well.

timezone.description: The user's IANA timezone, e.g. "Europe/Berlin" or "Asia/Tokyo". Decides what "due today" and "which day" mean. Defaults to UTC — pass it whenever you know it.

tools.name: get_memo_activity
tools.description: The user's study activity per day (reviews, correct answers, cards added), current and longest streak, and retention %. Use it to encourage them or to say which days they studied. Requires a personal access token with the "memo" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

timezone.description: The user's IANA timezone, e.g. "Europe/Berlin" or "Asia/Tokyo". Decides what "due today" and "which day" mean. Defaults to UTC — pass it whenever you know it.

tools.name: list_forms
tools.description: List the user's Datronis forms (and forms shared with them) with status, mode, response counts and public links. Requires a personal access token with the "forms" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

tools.name: get_form
tools.description: Get one form: its questions (with block ids for update_form), logic, theme, settings, validation issues and public link. Requires the "forms" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

form_id.description: Form id — from list_forms or create_form.

tools.name: create_form
tools.description: Create a form (as a draft). Give a plain-language description and Datronis designs the questions, or pass exact questions, or start from a template. The form is checked like any human-made form and cannot ask for passwords, card numbers, one-time codes or recovery phrases. Call publish_form to make it live. Requires the "forms" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

description.description: Describe the form in plain words and Datronis designs it (recommended).

language.description: Language to write the form in, e.g. "en", "fa", "de". Default "en".

type.description: Question type: short_text, long_text, email, phone, url, number, single_choice, multiple_choice, dropdown, yes_no, ranking, matrix, rating, opinion_scale, nps, slider, likert, date, time, datetime, date_range, file_upload, audio, video, address, consent.

options.description: Choices for choice/ranking types; statements for likert.

correct.description: Quiz mode: correct option texts, or a number.

questions.description: Exact questions to use instead of (or with no) description.

template.description: Start from a gallery template key, e.g. "job_application", "nps", "course_quiz", "event_rsvp".

tools.name: update_form
tools.description: Edit a form's draft with a list of operations (add/update/remove/move questions, set title/theme/layout). All-or-nothing; returns the updated form and validation issues. Requires the "forms" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

form_id.description: Form id — from list_forms or create_form.

operations.description: Applied in order, all-or-nothing. Each item is one of: {"op":"add_question","question":{...same shape as create_form questions},"after":"<blockId>|null"}, {"op":"update_question","blockId","title?","description?","required?","options?":[...]}, {"op":"remove_question","blockId","force?"}, {"op":"move_question","blockId","after":"<blockId>|null"}, {"op":"set","title?","description?","theme?":"minimal|paper|midnight|pastel|brutalist|glass|editorial|terminal|neon|nature|corporate|playful|monochrome|sunset|ocean|academic|luxury|default","layout?":"classic|one_at_a_time|conversation"}. Changes go to the draft; call publish_form to make them live.

tools.name: publish_form
tools.description: Publish the current draft so respondents see it, returning the public link. If the change affects questions that already have answers, it is refused unless confirm_data_impact is true. Requires the "forms" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

form_id.description: Form id — from list_forms or create_form.

confirm_data_impact.description: Set true to publish even though the change affects questions that already have answers.

tools.name: set_form_status
tools.description: Close a published form (stop accepting responses) or reopen it. Requires the "forms" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

form_id.description: Form id — from list_forms or create_form.

status.description: closed = stop accepting responses; published = reopen.

tools.name: list_form_responses
tools.description: List submitted responses to a form (answers keyed by block id; get_form maps ids to questions). Reviewers only see responses assigned to them; blind review hides identities. Requires the "forms" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

form_id.description: Form id — from list_forms or create_form.

tools.name: get_form_response
tools.description: Get one response with answers, score, files (short-lived download links), reviews and pipeline stage. Requires the "forms" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

form_id.description: Form id — from list_forms or create_form.

tools.name: get_form_summary
tools.description: Aggregated results per question (counts, averages, NPS, rankings incl. instant-runoff winners) plus views, completion rate and the drop-off funnel. Requires the "forms" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

form_id.description: Form id — from list_forms or create_form.

tools.name: get_form_insights
tools.description: AI insights on a form's responses: a summary, main themes with verbatim quotes, mood and suspicious responses. Sensitive answers are never analysed. Requires the "forms" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

form_id.description: Form id — from list_forms or create_form.

tools.name: update_form_response
tools.description: Manage a response: move it to a pipeline stage (moves its Kanban card too), tag, star or add private notes. Requires the "forms" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

form_id.description: Form id — from list_forms or create_form.

stage.description: Pipeline stage, e.g. New, Screening, Interview, Offer, Hired, Rejected.

tools.name: review_form_response
tools.description: Fill in or update your interview/application scorecard for a response. Requires the "forms" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

form_id.description: Form id — from list_forms or create_form.

scores.description: Scorecard item id → score (see get_form: content.modeConfig.interview.scorecard).

tools.name: export_form_responses
tools.description: Export all responses as CSV text or JSON (up to 2,000 rows here; use the web app for larger exports and Excel). Requires the "forms" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

form_id.description: Form id — from list_forms or create_form.

tools.name: list_diagrams
tools.description: List the authenticated user's saved diagrams (name, theme, public flag, timestamps — not the full Mermaid source; call get_diagram for that). Requires a personal access token with the "diagram" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

tools.name: get_diagram
tools.description: Get one diagram's full Mermaid source, theme, Global Settings, and node overrides. Requires a personal access token with the "diagram" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

diagram_id.description: Diagram id — from list_diagrams or create_diagram.

tools.name: create_diagram
tools.description: Create a new diagram from Mermaid source — flowcharts, sequence diagrams, mind maps, ER diagrams, Gantt charts, and anything else Mermaid supports. Requires a personal access token with the "diagram" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

code.description: Mermaid diagram source, e.g. "flowchart TD\n  A --> B".

theme_id.description: One of the Diagram Maker theme ids, e.g. "minimal-flat", "dark-console", "neon", "cartoon". Omit to keep the current theme.

is_public.description: Public diagrams can be read (not edited) by anyone with the link.

tools.name: update_diagram
tools.description: Update a diagram: rename it, replace its Mermaid source entirely, change its theme or Global Settings, or set its node overrides. Only fields you pass change — to edit the diagram's content, pass the complete new `code`, not a fragment. Requires a personal access token with the "diagram" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

diagram_id.description: Diagram id — from list_diagrams or create_diagram.

code.description: Full replacement Mermaid source — this tool rewrites the whole diagram, not a patch to one node.

theme_id.description: One of the Diagram Maker theme ids, e.g. "minimal-flat", "dark-console", "neon", "cartoon". Omit to keep the current theme.

node_overrides.description: Per-node drag position/color overrides, keyed by node id — as the editor itself stores them.

tools.name: delete_diagram
tools.description: Permanently delete a diagram. Cannot be undone. Requires a personal access token with the "diagram" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

diagram_id.description: Diagram id — from list_diagrams or create_diagram.

tools.name: duplicate_diagram
tools.description: Copy an existing diagram (including one that is public but not yours) into a new diagram you own. Requires a personal access token with the "diagram" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

diagram_id.description: Diagram id — from list_diagrams or create_diagram.

name.description: Name for the copy. Default: "<original name> (copy)".

tools.name: list_my_listings
tools.description: List the job listings you manage on Datronis (as owner, admin or recruiter of the company): title, status, applications and how many are unread, public and workspace URLs. Requires the "employer" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token with the "employer" scope (create it at /app/api-keys/ → Custom → Employer). Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. Acts as you: only the companies and listings you manage.

tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: List applications to your listings, newest first: candidate name and headline, status, match score, whether it was read, and the ATS state when the listing is connected to Greenhouse or Lever. Use get_application for the resume, cover letter and conversation. Requires the "employer" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token with the "employer" scope (create it at /app/api-keys/ → Custom → Employer). Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. Acts as you: only the companies and listings you manage.

job_id.description: One listing (from list_my_listings). Omit for every listing you manage.

tools.name: get_application
tools.description: One application in full: the resume (titles, companies, dates, skills, summary), cover letter, your private notes, the conversation with the candidate and the ATS state. Contact details follow the candidate's choice. Requires the "employer" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token with the "employer" scope (create it at /app/api-keys/ → Custom → Employer). Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. Acts as you: only the companies and listings you manage.

tools.name: update_application_status
tools.description: Move an application to a new status (e.g. SHORTLISTED, INTERVIEW_SCHEDULED, REJECTED). The candidate is told, exactly as when you change it in the workspace. Requires the "employer" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token with the "employer" scope (create it at /app/api-keys/ → Custom → Employer). Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. Acts as you: only the companies and listings you manage.

status.description: The candidate is told about the change.

notes.description: Private notes for your team (replaces the current notes). Never shown to the candidate.

tools.name: reply_to_candidate
tools.description: Write to the candidate of one application. It reaches them in Datronis and by email, through the same channel as the workspace; messages that look like job scams (fees, ID documents, off-platform payment) are held for review. Never ask for money or documents. Requires the "employer" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token with the "employer" scope (create it at /app/api-keys/ → Custom → Employer). Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. Acts as you: only the companies and listings you manage.

message.description: Plain text. Reaches the candidate in Datronis and by email; checked for scam patterns first.

tools.name: post_job
tools.description: Create a job listing for a company you own or administer. Saved as a draft unless publish is true; publishing counts toward your free listings and fails clearly when none are left. Requires the "employer" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token with the "employer" scope (create it at /app/api-keys/ → Custom → Employer). Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. Acts as you: only the companies and listings you manage.

company_id.description: A company you own or administer (see list_my_listings → company.id).

publish.description: Default false = saved as a draft for you to review. true publishes now (counts toward your free listings).

tools.name: create_quote_draft
tools.description: Create a quote DRAFT in your Datronis account — from an estimate (estimate_project_price), from a priced gig, or blank. Lines, hours and milestones are filled in (milestones always add up to the total); the client's page and PDF use the language you choose. It is NEVER sent: you review and send it yourself from the returned link. Free accounts make 3 quotes a month (drafts count). Requires the "freelance" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token with the "freelance" scope (create it at /app/api-keys/ → Custom → Quotes). Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. Acts as you: the draft is created in your own account.

estimate_id.description: An estimate id from estimate_project_price. Its lines, hours and "not included" items become the quote; with PRO, your rate sheet prices the hours.

gig_id.description: Or a gig that was priced with the estimator (its id), to quote for it.

tier.description: Which tier of the estimate to quote (default: your rate sheet's tier, else PROFESSIONAL).

client_risk.description: Sets the deposit milestone from your rate sheet (default medium).

client_email.description: Stored on the draft; nothing is emailed until you send the quote yourself.

locale.description: The language of the client's page and PDF (default en).

currency.description: USD quotes are paid in USDC once they become a contract (default USDC).
